load_video_decode_from_url: load a video from a URL or local path using a specified backend like pyav or decord
convert_video_to_rgb: convert a video numpy array from RGBA or grayscale format to RGB by blending or repeating channels
pad_video_frames: pad a video numpy array with specified height and width padding using constant, reflect, replicate, or symmetric mode
create_video_metadata: create a VideoMetadata dataclass instance with total frames, fps, width, height, duration, and backend info
group_videos_by_shape: group a list of torch tensor videos by their shape and number of frames, then stack them into batches
